correction.summary: The EasyGL Model draw, hierarchy, two-mesh, skinned-playback and .cnj reader programs are reused verbatim as CTests on SOFTWARE, VULKAN, SDL_GPU, OPENGL4 and the DirectX parity set, but no workflow runs those registrations; the whole-corpus L7 image campaigns for VULKAN, SOFTWARE and DIRECTX11 are committed reports from one earlier commit, not CI jobs.
correction.actual: The easygl_model_* sources are compiled unchanged by modules/renderers/software/examples/CMakeLists.txt (Software_ModelDraw_RedQuad and Software_Model_*), modules/renderers/vulkan/examples/CMakeLists.txt (Vulkan_Model_*), modules/renderers/sdl-gpu/examples/CMakeLists.txt (SdlGpu_EasyGLOracle_model_*), modules/renderers/opengl4/examples/EasyGLParityCorpus.cmake and cmake/DirectXParityTests.cmake; HEADLESS has a Model::Draw check in headless_effects_test.cpp and SDL_RENDERER has the refusal test sdlrenderer_model_draw_throws_test.cpp. No workflow runs any of these non-EasyGL registrations: platform-ci.yml builds SOFTWARE and VULKAN with examples but filters ctest to platform tests, and gltf-renderer-stride-ci.yml builds CnaTests only. What CI does run on VULKAN, SOFTWARE and OPENGLES3 is RendererStrideConformance (a real Model::Draw plus Present per glTF stride that passes on no throw or a named refusal, with no pixel check) and the L0-L6 ladder; the l7-corpus job runs the whole-corpus image rung for OPENGLES3 only. The VULKAN, SOFTWARE and DIRECTX11 (under DXVK) whole-corpus results are the committed reports docs/gltf-l7-vulkan-corpus-report.json, docs/gltf-l7-software-corpus-report.json and docs/gltf-l7-directx11-report.json, captured on 2026-08-18 at CNA commit b6c180fd.

refutation_attempt: Read the shim test, public Keyboard::GetState (reads IPlatformKeyboard, not InputManager), the P11 tasks and the verification matrix; then searched platform tests for focus-loss coverage and found Win32 and Wayland tests, so 'not tested per platform' is too strong.
reason: Hardware matrix and blocked P11 checklist are confirmed, and the shim test does read InputManager. But focus-loss key release through the platform keyboard is tested for Wayland (snapshot after leave) and Win32 (event mapper); X11 releases keys on FocusOut with no test, SDL3 has none.

correction.actual: plans/plan_input.md Phase 11 (P11-001..015, the manual hardware checklist) is open, every task marked blocked, and the hardware matrix in docs/input-manual-verification-results.md has every controller, touchscreen, IME and Czech-layout cell unchecked. WindowFocusLostDoesNotClearHeldKeysMatchingFna in modules/input/tests/CNA/Internal/Input/SdlInputBridgeKeyboardTests.cpp reads a file-local Keyboard struct whose GetState is InputManager::GetKeyboardState(); the public Keyboard::GetState reads the platform keyboard snapshot (IPlatformKeyboard), and no test reads it across focus loss. Platform-level focus-loss release is pinned only for Wayland (WaylandProtocol.KeysHeldAtEnterAreStateNotEventsAndLeaveReleasesThemQuietly, in a suite no workflow runs) and, at event-mapper level, for Win32 (Win32EventMapping.TracksHeldKeysAndReleasesThemOnFocusLoss); X11 releases all keys on FocusOut and SDL3 reads SDL's keyboard state, with no focus-loss test for either.
correction.evidence_note: Checked by reading at 009d40f5; not executed. Platform focus-loss tests found by searching modules/platform/tests and modules/input/tests for FocusLost, FocusOut and KILLFOCUS.
